Method of Attack: Encrypts data files by appending .id-[id].[email].bip extension
Encrypts mapped network drives, shared virtual machine host drives, and unmapped network shares
Deletes all shadow volume copies using vssadmin delete shadows /all /quiet
Creates ransom notes Info.hta and FILES ENCRYPTED.txt
Configures itself to auto-start on Windows login to encrypt new files
Impacted Systems: Windows computers with Remote Desktop Services
Attack Vector: Hacking into Remote Desktop Services and manual installation
Indicators of Compromise: Registry entries under HKEY_CURRENT_USER and HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE for filename.exe and mshta.exe launching Info.hta
